messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "change how your blood clots and you may need extra monitoring"
set: ["change how your blood clots and you may need extra monitoring", "prevent blood clots", "change how much is in your body", "raise blood sugar and your doses may need to go up", "blood clots happening again", "treatment for blood clots", "your heart and blood pressure may also need to be checked often", "some patients may not need extra potassium at all", "you may not notice any change in your symptoms", "you may need regular blood tests, blood pressure checks and eye checks during long-term treatment", "you may need to use blood pressure medication for the rest of your life", "avoid driving and other tasks that need alertness until you know how it affects you", "dose may need adjusting", "how hard your heart squeezes", "doctor may change your dose if kidney function changes", "heart monitoring with ecg"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
